verdict.rationale: Mercury's API/CLI expose list/create endpoints for cards, transactions, invoices, customers etc., and a community power-user reports creating 'hundreds' of virtual cards and 'dozens' of accounts, showing bulk workflows are achievable via scripting. However, the documented API/CLI endpoints are single-item CRUD (no native batch-create endpoints), and the MCP server is read-only with 31 get/list tools only, so true one-call bulk operations aren't evidenced—only scripted iteration.
